sample_unit: model responses (Kimi chat, Stage 2; 40 questions x 4 repetitions x 3 raters)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across repeated runs of the same question
links.effect: Across 240 model responses, repeatability ≥70% was reached in 66.7% of responses.
links.quote: Across 240 model responses, the proportions were: accuracy ≥ 3: 83.8%, completeness=3: 77.9%, and repeatability≥70%: 66.7%.
